review_locator: PMCID:PMC4621791, Of ITIMs, ITAMs and ITAMis, revisiting Immunoglobulin Fc Receptor signaling
primary_title: Downstream signaling molecules bind to different phosphorylated immunoreceptor tyrosine-based activation motif peptides of the high affinity IgE receptor
decision_basis: Tyrosine-diphosphorylated FcεRI gamma ITAM preferentially recruits Syk in phosphopeptide precipitation and SH2-domain membrane-binding assays, with receptor-linked mast-cell signaling semantics
limitations_preserved: Promote the FcRγ diphospho-ITAM-to-SYK docking/activation branch; preserve the FcεRI gamma receptor-complex context and requirement for dual phosphorylation, without transferring beta-ITAM adaptor results or inferring SCI/terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC10779339, B-Cell Receptor Signaling and Beyond: The Role of Igα/Igβ in Normal and Malignant B Cells; PMCID:PMC2845712, Organization of proximal signal initiation at the TCR:CD3 complex
primary_title: Syk, but not Lyn, recruitment to B cell antigen receptor and activation following stimulation of CD45- B cells
decision_basis: Antigen-induced phosphorylation of CD79a and CD79b ITAMs is followed by Syk recruitment and activation at the B-cell antigen receptor in receptor-expressing plasmacytoma cells
limitations_preserved: Promote the CD79A/CD79B phosphorylated-ITAM-to-SYK BCR relay; preserve paired CD79A/CD79B and B-cell receptor context, without assigning one chain or ITAM as uniquely sufficient or inferring SCI/terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2845712, Organization of proximal signal initiation at the TCR:CD3 complex
primary_title: The protein interactions of the immunoglobulin receptor family tyrosine-based activation motifs present in the T cell receptor zeta subunits and the CD3 gamma, delta and epsilon chains; Functional analysis of ITAM-mediated signal transduction
decision_basis: Doubly phosphorylated CD3 gamma, delta, epsilon and zeta ITAMs bind ZAP-70 with a defined affinity hierarchy, and paired-tyrosine mutation disrupts stable ZAP-70 binding and T-cell signaling
limitations_preserved: Promote the TCR/CD3 phosphorylated-ITAM-to-ZAP70 relay as a site-set/family-complex identity; preserve the affinity hierarchy and paired ITAM semantics, with no single-chain exclusivity, SCI transfer or terminal-TF inference.
